name: Polymarket
rootCause: According to a post by crypto trader @25usdc, hackers are exploiting the comment section of Polymarket to carry out scam activities, resulting in losses exceeding $500,000. The attackers post links to their phishing websites in an obfuscated, non-plain-text format. When users log in to these sites via email, malicious scripts are injected, leading to data breaches and the loss of funds.

descriptions.text: According to a post by crypto trader @25usdc, hackers are exploiting the comment section of Polymarket to carry out scam activities, resulting in losses exceeding $500,000. The attackers post links to their phishing websites in an obfuscated, non-plain-text format. When users log in to these sites via email, malicious scripts are injected, leading to data breaches and the loss of funds.

In November 2025, scammers abused Polymarket comment sections to distribute obfuscated phishing links that redirected users to fake “private market” pages and malicious scripts. Public reports attributed more than $500,000 in user losses to credential theft and wallet compromise rather than a smart contract flaw in Polymarket itself. Public reporting describes a phishing and malware distribution campaign that abused Polymarket’s comment system and user trust. Attackers posted disguised links to fake Polymarket pages, induced users to execute malicious terminal commands or submit login credentials, and then used the captured data to access accounts and drain funds.…
